title: A wider telescope aperture
hook: Change aperture diameter and predict angular resolution limit.
misconception: angular resolution limit doubles when aperture diameter doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply θ ≈ 1.22λ/D to compare angular resolution limit when aperture diameter changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a circular aperture under the Rayleigh criterion with fixed wavelength, θ ≈ 1.22λ/D. When aperture diameter doubles, angular resolution limit becomes ½ times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model θ ≈ 1.22λ/D; scaling exponent -1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a circular aperture under the Rayleigh criterion with fixed wavelength, with a nonzero initial result. If aperture diameter triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on angular resolution limit?
recall.why: Apply θ ≈ 1.22λ/D under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 1/3.
